highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.158 line adopts Skia m158 while preserving the existing managed binding surface.
highlights_body: The collected changes also correct calling conventions in source-generated native imports. Native HarfBuzz remains at 14.4.0; its package revision changes do not represent an engine upgrade.

breaking.title: Check Graphite Metal deployment targets
breaking.body: Graphite Metal adopts an iOS and tvOS runtime minimum of 15; raise deployment targets for applications using this backend where necessary. Its macOS minimum remains 12. Retain any higher managed or framework requirements.

bullets.detail: Advances the native renderer through m157 to m158 without adding C bridge exports or changing the managed binding surface.
Source-generated LibraryImport declarations now use the same cdecl convention as the existing import and delegate paths, correcting an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86 calls.
